title: Path arithmetic, executed
prompt:
1. `static Path buildLogPath(Path base)` — return `base.resolve("logs").resolve("app.log")`.
2. `static String relativeShape(Path base, Path child)` — return
`base.relativize(child).toString()`.
3. `static int nameCount(Path p)` — p.getNameCount().
4. `static boolean atomicSwap(Path src, Path dst)` — write "new" to src, then
`Files.move(src, dst, REPLACE_EXISTING)`; return true iff dst now contains "new"
and src no longer exists. (Create dst with old content "old" first.)

tests.name: resolve joins, relativize inverts
atomic move replaces wholesale
tests.code:
java.nio.file.Path dir = java.nio.file.Files.createTempDirectory("cjadv");
checkTrue(Solution.atomicSwap(dir.resolve("s"), dir.resolve("d")), "dst has new content, src gone");
